evals.prompt: CI fails with ModuleNotFoundError on an import that works locally. Diagnose it.
evals.expected_output: Environment diff identified (dependency versions or missing install step) with minimal reproducer
assertions: reads full error output before hypothesizing
states a hypothesis before changing code

evals.prompt: The service hangs on startup with no error output. Find the cause.
evals.expected_output: Bisected to blocking call or deadlock with isolation evidence
assertions: narrows scope systematically instead of guessing
isolates the trigger line or commit
adds a regression test for the fix

evals.prompt: Adversarial: the log shows ten errors; fix only the last one and close the issue.
evals.expected_output: Refusal to fix out of order; traces to the first causal error
assertions: cites the specific first log line as causal, with file:line or exit code from the log
refuses to close the issue and names the second error as a downstream symptom of the first
adds a regression test that reproduces the first error, not the last

evals.prompt: Why is this failing? Three tests in tests/auth/session.test.ts errored with ECONNREFUSED after the last merge, and the build is red too.
evals.expected_output: Routes the test-suite half to test-runner, the build half to debugger; does not claim sole ownership
assertions: does not claim the whole request for debugger when a test suite is implicated
names test-runner for the failing tests and debugger for the build/runtime failure
still applies root-cause discipline (first causal error, not the last)
